\\ISP Reimbursement Form_Master - 1st Q - final.docx 9/29/2022 12:10 PM Page 1 Internet Service Provider (ISP) Reimbursement Agreement PURPOSE The purpose of this Agreement is to partially compensate employees of Idaho Public Television (Agency) for appropriate business use of their personal internet service provider (ISP) equipment and service costs . CONDITIONS AND UNDERSTANDINGS • I am free to use the ISP of my choice, given I maintain the equipment and service plan to meet the business needs of this Agreement for the entire duration of its term. • The equipment I use to login to the State of Idaho/Idaho Public Television resources must have up -to-date software, browser, and virus/malware applications and be used in compliance with Idaho Technology Authority’s policies (https://ita.idaho.gov/resources/). • Idaho Public Television is not responsible for any overage fees, service fees, equipment replacement costs, payment of the employee’s personal service plan/invoice(s), or any other related costs of the employee’s ISP Agreement. • The reimbursement may not exceed the amount paid by the employee for the related service. • Idaho Public Television will reimburse in the amount and of the frequency listed below to the address on file with the State of Idaho (vendor address). • I further agree to immediately notify my supervisor when any working conditions change that alter the business use of my ISP under the terms above, or if I am no longer maintaining an ISP and service plan that meets the needs of this agreement. EMPLOYEE AND SERVICE INFORMATION Name: Logan Finney Department: Production Address: 573 S Curtis Rd #104, Boise, ID 83705 Business Purpose: ISP access for business use in support of an alternative work location and hours. Quarterly Reimbursement Amount: ISP: $120.00/qtr. Duration: 7/1/2022 – 9/30/2022 (1st Q FY23) ISP Account #: 132010307 I, the below-signed, attest to the following: • I will immediately notify my supervisor when my working conditions change that alter the business use or business need of my personal ISP under the terms above, or if I am no longer maintaining an ISP and service plan that meets the needs of this agreement • I understand and agree to all other terms and conditions within this Agreement.
